top_categories.workout_context: 51ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Granfondo Bratislava's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before August.
At Granfondo Bratislava, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.

Road-specific control matters at Granfondo Bratislava. Practice on mixed terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 82 miles.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Granfondo Bratislava. Train it until it feels boring.
When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
At mile 60 of 82, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
Varied gradients on mixed terrain demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 82 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Granfondo Bratislava. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 82 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 4,219ft of climbing on mixed terrain does to your power file on race day.

race_overlay.weather: August in Bratislava, Slovakia. Rehearse adaptable layers and race-day kit changes in the final 2 weeks before Granfondo Bratislava. Use the organizer's current forecast and safety instructions for final choices.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Granfondo Bratislava’s 82 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.altitude: Altitude may change sustainable power and recovery at Granfondo Bratislava. Use conservative pacing and test any travel strategy before the event.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at Granfondo Bratislava rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on mixed terrain to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Race Simulation, and Over Under to prepare you for 82 miles of mixed terrain in Bratislava, Slovakia.
